rationale: Minimize cost by maximizing inverter active output to its availability limit (p_inv=20 => p_diesel=34-20=14), which attains the diesel pmin lower bound and minimizes active cost. Set q_diesel to its preferred value 4 mvar (zero deviation penalty), so q_inv=12-4=8 mvar. Inverter apparent power 20^2+8^2=464 <= 24^2=576 is feasible; diesel q=4 within [-10,18]; voltage = 0.965 + 0.0025*(4+8) = 0.995 pu within [0.95,1.05]. Cost = 14*76 + 3*|4-4| = 1064.
